# Appendix

#### Table S0. Construction of the credit and financial-service variables from the GLSS Section 12a questionnaires

| Analysis variable | GLSS6 item | GLSS7 item | Question wording | Response options |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Credit access** | | | | |
| `Applied` | s12aq7 | s12aq7 | Has [NAME] applied for a loan from a financial institution in the last 12 months? | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Accept`, `Refused`, `Proces` | s12aq8 | s12aq8a, s12aq8b, s12aq8c | GLSS6: Was the loan application granted? GLSS7: What is/was the status of the loan application? | GLSS6: 1 Yes, 2 No. GLSS7: 1 Granted, 2 Processing, 3 Not granted |
| `LoanAmt` | s12aq10 | s12aq10 | Total amount of original loan | Continuous, cedis; deflated to 2016/17 prices |
| `RePaid` | s12aq13 | s12aq13 | Amount of loan repaid (including charges etc.) | Continuous, cedis; deflated to 2016/17 prices |
| `credit_self` | derived | derived | Applied, granted, and a positive amount recorded | 0, 1 |
| **`credit_hh`** (treatment) | derived | derived | `credit_self` for the operator, spouse, a child, or any other household member | 0, 1 |
| `credit_spouse` | derived | derived | `credit_self` for the spouse, via the roster link | 0, 1 |
| `credit_child` | derived | derived | `credit_self` for a child, via the maternal and paternal roster links | 0, 1 |
| `credit_close` | derived | derived | `credit_spouse` or `credit_child` | 0, 1 |
| `credit_member` | derived | derived | Household has credit and neither the operator, spouse, nor a child does | 0, 1 |
| **Loan characteristics** | | | | |
| Source of loan | s12aq9 | s12aq9a to s12aq9c | Source of loan | 1 State bank, 2 Private bank, 3 Cooperative, 4 Government agency, 5 NGO, 6 Business firm, 7 Employer, 8 Money lender, 9 Savings and loan scheme, 10 Susu scheme, 11 Trader, 12 Farmer |
| Purpose of loan | s12aq11 | s12aq11a to s12aq11c | Purpose of loan | 1 Day-to-day expenses, 2 Emergency, 3 Pay off debts, 4 Pay off another's debts, 5 Social reasons, 6 Education, 7 Rent, 8 Purchase or build a house, 9 Improve house, 10 Household assets, 11 Vehicle, 12 Land |
| Collateral | s12aq12 | s12aq12a to s12aq12c | Kind of guarantee required by lender | 1 None, 2 Land, 3 Cattle, 4 House or building, 5 Employer, 6 Relatives, 7 Non-relatives, 8 Land title, 9 Salary channelled through lender, 10 Vehicle documents, 11 Cash or bank account, 12 Third-party security |
| Reason for refusal | s12aq14 | s12aq14 | Why was the loan refused? | 1 Could not provide collateral, 2 Salary or income too low, 3 Could not get a guarantor, 4 Amount applied for too high, 5 Previous debt problems, 6 Inappropriate purpose, 7 Other |
| Reason for not applying | s12aq15 | s12aq15 | What was the main reason for not trying to obtain a loan? | 1 No need, 2 Interest rate too high, 3 Demand for collateral, 4 Already has too much debt, 5 Cannot obtain the amount needed, 6 Other |
| **Account ownership** | | | | |
| `Banked` | s12aq1 | s12aq1 | Does [NAME] have a bank account? | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| Reason for no account | s12aq2 | s12aq2 | What is the main reason for not having a bank account? | 1 Not necessary or interested, 2 Not aware of one, 3 Process cumbersome, 4 Institution too far away, 5 Not enough money or income, 6 No regular income, 7 Other |
| **Type of institution** | | | | |
| `InstTyp_Bank` | s12aq3a, s12aq3c | s12aq3a, s12aq3c | Is the account in a commercial bank? In a community or rural bank? | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `InstTyp_Invt` | s12aq3b | s12aq3b | Investment or mortgage institution | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `InstTyp_Save` | s12aq3d | s12aq3d | Savings and loans scheme | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `InstTyp_Coop` | s12aq3e | s12aq3e | Cooperative or credit union | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `InstTyp_Susu` | s12aq3f | s12aq3f | Susu scheme | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `InstTyp_Momo` | not asked | s12aq3g | Mobile money | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| **Type of account** | | | | |
| `AccTyp_Curnt` | s12aq4a, s12aq4e | s12aq4a, s12aq4f | Current or cheque account; e-zwich account | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `AccTyp_Save` | s12aq4c, s12aq4d | s12aq4c, s12aq4d, s12aq4e | Savings account; susu account (GLSS7 only); fixed deposit account | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `AccTyp_Invst` | s12aq4b | s12aq4b | Investment account | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| **Transaction products** | | | | |
| `PrdTyp_Cheq` | s12aq5a | s12aq5a | Bank transaction product used: cheque book | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `PrdTyp_ATM` | s12aq5b, s12aq5c | s12aq5b, s12aq5c | ATM card; e-zwich | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `PrdTyp_Ebnk` | s12aq5d | s12aq5d | Electronic banking | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| **Source of knowledge** | | | | |
| `Bank_Info` | s12aq6 | s12aq6 | How did [NAME] come to know about the financial institution? | 1 Radio, 2 Television, 3 Newspaper or magazine, 4 Colleagues or relatives, 5 Representative of the institution, 6 Employer or union, 7 Community or association leaders; GLSS6: 8 Other; GLSS7: 8 ICT medium, 9 Other |
| **Insurance** | | | | |
| `Insured` | s12aq16 | s12aq16 | Do you have an insurance policy? | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Car` | s12aq18a | s12aq18a | Type of short-term insurance: vehicle or motor | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Health` | s12aq18b | s12aq18b | Type of short-term insurance: medical | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Death` | s12aq18c | s12aq18c | Type of short-term insurance: funeral | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Asset` | s12aq18d | s12aq18d | Type of short-term insurance: property | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Buss` | s12aq18e | s12aq18e | Type of short-term insurance: commercial or business | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Travel` | s12aq18f | s12aq18f | Type of short-term insurance: travel | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Life` | s12aq19a, s12aq19b | s12aq19a, s12aq19b | Long-term cover: life insurance, premium paid by holder or by employer | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Pension` | s12aq19c | s12aq19c | Long-term cover: retirement annuity or plan | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Edu` | s12aq19d | s12aq19d | Long-term cover: education | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| `Insured_Invest` | s12aq19e | s12aq19e | Long-term cover: other endowment or investment saving plan | 1 Yes, 2 No |
| **Community amenities** | | | | |
| `BankKm`, `RoadKm`, `TrnprtKm` | community module | community module | Distance to the nearest bank, motorable road, and public transport | Continuous, km; minimum within the enumeration area |

*Notes*: Items are drawn from Part B, Section 12a of each questionnaire
(`sec12a` in GLSS6, `g7sec12a` in GLSS7); GLSS7 suffixes multi-response items
with `_a`, `_b` and so on, which the harmonization strips. Wording is
reproduced from the survey instruments. Loan detail is elicited only from
respondents who applied and were granted a loan, so the credit indicator is the
conjunction of application, approval and a positive amount rather than a test on
the amount alone. Mobile money and susu accounts do not appear in the GLSS6
instrument, so their zero entries in Table 2 denote items not asked rather than
an absence of holdings; the GLSS6 columns for the remaining institution and
account items are re-indexed onto the GLSS7 positions before the rounds are
pooled. GLSS7 records the status, source, purpose and collateral of up to three
loans but a single loan amount, and adds a "processing" outcome that GLSS6 does
not offer. The source-of-knowledge item is reported in Table 2 but is not
discussed in the text; its derived category indicators do not currently
reproduce the response order shown above, and the block is withheld from the
narrative pending correction. Distances are taken from the community
questionnaire rather than from Section 12a.
